item.text:
REVIEW_DECISION: REJECT
RISK_CLASS: high-impact
SUMMARY: Execution receipts are not cryptographically bound to the harness. The schema’s constant `recorded_by` field is only a claim and can be copied by a model, allowing fabricated gates and acceptance evidence to validate. This violates the prohibition on model self-certification.
FINDING: critical|docs/factory-ng/schemas/factory.execution-receipt-v1.schema.json|Accepted execution receipts require only `recorded_by: factory-harness/v1`, with no trusted harness attestation|A model can emit a schema-valid accepted receipt and falsely self-certify passing gates, violating immutable-receipt and Factory-owned acceptance requirements
REQUIRED_CHANGE: Require and verify a harness-generated cryptographic attestation over the complete execution receipt, or validate it against an independently trusted immutable harness record; add a negative fixture for a structurally valid but unattested accepted receipt.
COUNTEREXAMPLE: Claude outputs the contents of `valid-execution-receipt.json`, replacing identities and hashes with invented values while retaining `recorded_by: factory-harness/v1`; the current schema and receipt validator accept it as harness evidence.
